description: Proxy a JSON-RPC call to a blockchain node.

chain.description: Chain name (e.g., ETH, BSC, SOL, ARB, POLYGON)

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

method.description: RPC method name (e.g., eth_blockNumber, eth_getBalance, getLatestBlockhash)

params.description: RPC method parameters as JSON array

name: dex_rpc_call
